facts.fact: The SONSA report, by Capital University of Somalia, says Somalia lacks the institutional capacity and normative clarity to regulate AI and needs AI-specific safeguards such as protection against deepfakes added to its legal frameworks.

SOM.note: The document states nothing on government use of AI.
The document calls for AI-specific safeguards in existing law but names no law or draft on AI.
The document states nothing on AI in a sector's public system.
The document states nothing on AI built or hosted in Somalia.
The document mentions data protection laws only in general terms, with no Somali law, status or authority stated.

facts.fact: SONSA published a 20-page research report on AI and digital rights in Somalia carried out by Capital University of Somalia, analysing government policies and private sector practices.
facts.system: Artificial Intelligence and Digital Rights in Somalia
